verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an AI Assistant integrated into the Dashboard that provides context-aware support and automates repetitive database management tasks (docs-19, docs-41), and its MCP server/agent-skills let external AI assistants query and reason about project data on the user's behalf (docs-1, docs-2). However, this is more 'AI assists with database ops' than deep 'AI-generated insights/suggestions from your data' (e.g., no evidence of analytics-style insight generation, anomaly detection, or proactive data-driven suggestions beyond advisors which are deterministic rule checks, not AI-generated). missing for 10: evidence of AI generating analytical insights/trends from stored data, first-party proof of insight quality, independent hands-on validation of the AI Assistant's suggestions.
